conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLA: EO 11748 Sec. 6 superseded EO 11726 only to the extent inconsistent (a partial change), but EO 11775 Sec. 1 of March 26, 1974 abolishes the Energy Policy Office and supersedes the whole of EO 11726 without qualifier, and recites that the Office was continued on an interim basis after EO 11748. Every clause was checked against both instruments in the lifecycle sheet; the partial change does not alter the whole-order status NO, which rests on EO 11775.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: EO 11726 (June 29, 1973) established the Energy Policy Office in the Executive Office of the President under a Director, set the Director's responsibilities, provided expenses and support, set a report date of March 15, 1974, and superseded EO 11712 (abolishing the Special Committee on Energy and the National Energy Office). EO 11748 of December 4, 1973 (Federal Energy Office) superseded EO 11726 only "to the extent that it is inconsistent" with it. EO 11775 of March 26, 1974 states that the Energy Policy Office was continued in being on an interim basis to permit an orderly transition, and abolishes it and supersedes EO 11726 in its Section 1. The status is NO: the Office was abolished and the order superseded on March 26, 1974, and no held source revives it.
